page.content:
French officer of the war quartet who then goes home to his own revolution.

How Marquis de Lafayette connects

  • Character: Daveed Diggs — Daveed Diggs originated Lafayette in the first act.
  • Work: My Shot — Lafayette stands in the My Shot quartet.
  • Work: Yorktown (The World Turned Upside Down) — Lafayette takes the Yorktown redoubt beside Hamilton.

What is Marquis de Lafayette?

Lafayette is the French aristocrat in Hamilton's wartime friend group — with Laurens, Mulligan, and Hamilton — who ships home after Yorktown to fight another revolution.

Key threads lead to Daveed Diggs, My Shot and Yorktown (The World Turned Upside Down).
